title: ValueDCG: Measuring Comprehensive Human Value Understanding Ability of Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Value Discriminator-Critique Gap (ValueDCG) by comparing the model's accuracy in predicting human value labels from text ('know what') against its ability to explain the presence of those values through attribution analysis, counterfactual analysis, and rebuttal arguments evaluated by a GPT-4o judge ('know why').
